e.body: CAS（Casualty Actuarial Society，北美产险精算学会）的**基础教育教学大纲（Syllabus of Basic Education, SOBE）**是**产险精算考试的唯一官方考纲**：它逐科列出**学习目标（learning objectives）、指定参考文献与阅读范围**，并按 Bloom 认知层级（认知/应用/分析等）标注每项要求的掌握深度——这意味着它不只是「书单」，而是**命题与阅卷的依据**。CAS 每年发布新版 SOBE，并配有一篇解释性文章（What Is the CAS Syllabus of Basic Education?）说明大纲的作用与使用方法。对 RIAA：RIAA 的主线是产险与风险分析，因此**CAS 体系与本课程的相关度高于 SOA**；这份大纲是「**该读什么、读到什么程度才算会**」的权威标尺，也是判断某本教材/某篇论文是否在考纲内的依据；它与池内产险方法工具（[[chainladder-python]]、[[faslr]] 等 CAS 出品的准备金工具，研究资源见 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）构成「**考纲 → 方法 → 工具**」的完整链条；与 [[soa-education]]、[[ifoa-studying]] 对照可看清北美产险、北美寿险、英国三大体系的差异；就业侧见 [[cas-jobs]]；适合作考试规划、学习方法论与产险方向。说明：SOBE **按年度更新**，本条源链接为可核实的 2025 版官方 PDF（728KB），使用时应确认最新版年份。
e.body_en: The Casualty Actuarial Society’s (CAS) **Syllabus of Basic Education (SOBE)** is **the sole official syllabus for the casualty actuarial examinations**: it lists, exam by exam, the **learning objectives, prescribed references and reading ranges**, and tags each requirement with a Bloom cognitive level (knowledge/application/analysis and so on) — meaning it is not merely a reading list but **the basis for question setting and marking**. CAS issues a new SOBE each year and publishes an explainer article ("What Is the CAS Syllabus of Basic Education?") on its role and use. For RIAA: RIAA’s main line is general insurance and risk analytics, so **the CAS system is more relevant to this programme than the SOA’s**; this syllabus is the authoritative yardstick for "**what to read and to what depth counts as knowing it**", and the basis for judging whether a given textbook or paper is in scope; with the corpus’s general insurance method tools (CAS-produced reserving tools such as [[chainladder-python]] and [[faslr]], plus research resources [[cas-research-tools]] and [[astin-bulletin]]) it completes a "**syllabus → method → tool**" chain; comparing it with [[soa-education]] and [[ifoa-studying]] makes the differences among the North American casualty, North American life and UK systems clear; for employment see [[cas-jobs]]; suits exam planning, study methodology and general insurance work. Note: the SOBE is **reissued annually**; the source link here is the verifiable 2025 official PDF (728KB), so confirm the latest edition when using it.
e.body_hk: CAS（Casualty Actuarial Society，北美產險精算學會）的**基礎教育教學大綱（Syllabus of Basic Education, SOBE）**是**產險精算考試的唯一官方考綱**：它逐科列出**學習目標、指定參考文獻與閱讀範圍**，並按 Bloom 認知層級標註每項要求的掌握深度——這意味著它不只是「書單」，而是**命題與閱卷的依據**。CAS 每年發布新版 SOBE，並配有解釋性文章說明大綱的作用與使用方法。對 RIAA：RIAA 的主線是產險與風險分析，因此 **CAS 體系與本課程的相關度高於 SOA**；這份大綱是「**該讀什麼、讀到什麼程度才算會**」的權威標尺；它與池內產險方法工具（[[chainladder-python]]、[[faslr]]，研究資源見 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）構成「**考綱 → 方法 → 工具**」的完整鏈條；與 [[soa-education]]、[[ifoa-studying]] 對照可看清三大體系差異；就業側見 [[cas-jobs]]；適合作考試規劃、學習方法論與產險方向。說明：SOBE **按年度更新**，本條源鏈接為可核實的 2025 版官方 PDF（728KB）。
